відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The black pumps and clutch give the soft taupe suit two crisp dark accents, and the golden earrings add the only shine, which suits gold in your palette. This outfit is right for a family guest at an outdoor afternoon ceremony followed by a restaurant dinner. It is restrained and classic, as you asked, and the warm taupe stays well away from white, so the day belongs to the bride. The straight suit draws one clean vertical line from shoulders to hem, and the heels extend your legs below it, so the eye travels the full length of you. Heels on grass are the one thing the day argues with, and I still chose them because a wedding at this level of formality calls for them. Keep to paths and firm ground where you can, and you will stay comfortable from the ceremony through the dinner.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"On grass, keep your weight on the balls of your feet in the black pumps so the heels don't sink.\",\"Keep the golden earrings as the only shine against the plain suit, and don't add other metal.\",\"If the restaurant is warm, open the suit jacket so the line stays long and easy.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#89·11\",\"what\":\"taupe suit\"},{\"n\":\"#514·03\",\"what\":\"black pumps\"},{\"n\":\"#535·07\",\"what\":\"black clutch\"},{\"n\":\"#150·32\",\"what\":\"golden earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#89·11\",\"text\":\"A suit in a soft, warm taupe with a straight cut that falls in clean vertical lines. The muted colour keeps it calm and classic.\"},{\"n\":\"#514·03\",\"text\":\"Classic black pumps with a heel. They have a smooth, simple shape that lengthens the leg and keeps a formal finish.\"},{\"n\":\"#535·07\",\"text\":\"A black clutch, compact and neat. Its plain dark shape works as a quiet accent.\"},{\"n\":\"#150·32\",\"text\":\"Golden earrings with a bright shine. They are a refined, valuable piece that lights up the face.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":6805,"output_tokens":1762},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
